notes.title: Demo Refresh 4: Key Rebinding & In-game Options
notes.notes:
With players still testing out the previous balance changes, it was time to shift focus on making the game more player friendly! To that end the latest Demo update includes the following:

[b]Control re-binding:[/b]
[list]
[*] All keys/buttons can now be rebound in the Settings screen or Pause menu
[*] There are separate bindings for keyboard or controller, and the rebinding options will dynamically change based on which you are currently using
[*] The controller images default to Xbox, but should work with almost any controller including Steam Deck
[*] PS5 controller images will appear instead if that controller is in use - other images will be added later
[/list]

[b]In-Game Options Menu[/b]
[list]
[*] Pausing with Start (Controller) or Escape (Keyboard) now shows the full options menu
[*] The Settings screen has been updated to include a section for re-binding controls

I hope these changes make playing a bit more enjoyable!

notes.title: Demo Refresh 3: Major Updates & Balance Changes
notes.notes:
You spoke, I listened! This update includes made many changes, updates, and improvements to the demo. Please give it a shot and let me know what you think!

[b]Game Updates/Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] Enemies now show a short animation when they die rather than simply disappearing
[*] There is now an intro/tutorial screen that plays once - it can also be reviewed in the settings screen
[*] New sound effects for most game features
[*] New music track added for Stage 1
[*] Level up screen has been completely re-worked
[*] A notification appears when players unlock new specializations
[*] A notification appears after the first run to draw attention to the permanent upgrades
[*] The mouse cursor now gets out of the way when playing with keyboard or gamepad (click anywhere to bring it back)
[/list]

[b]Game Balance changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Early wave enemies have had their speed reduced
[*] Starting damage values have been increased for sword, shuriken, and clones
[*] Starting damage values have been drastically increased for traps and dodging
[*] Clones were missing too often and now throw 3 shuriken instead of 1
[*] Damage upgrades have also been increased for all weapons
[*] Damage now has a small amount of randomness/variation (between 5% and 10%)
[*] All enemies have had their health rebalanced to account for increased player damage (but in general are easier to kill now)
[*] The healing level up now just heals rather than also providing increased maximum health
[*] Traps now last until triggered by an enemy, and new ones are also available every 5 seconds
[*] Trap Frenzy Powerup now adds 10 additional traps and automatically deploys them
[*] Clone Frenzy Powerup now adds 10 additional clones and automatically deploys them
[*] Default range for emerald collection has been reduced
[/list]

[b]Many bug fixes including:[/b]
[list]
[*] Powerups no longer expire during level up screen
[*] Enemies no longer occasionally move when the game is paused
[*] You only have to click the demo acknowledgement once ever now
[*] The healing level up no longer appears if you have full health
[*] You can now un-pause the game with gamepads (B on Xbox, O on PlayStation, etc)
[*] Level Select has been changed to "Stage Select" to reduce ambiguity
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Refresh 2: New Enemies and Settings!
notes.notes:
I've been working on fixing bugs and responding to feedback you all have provided on the Demo version of Nine Live Ninja: Survive! Here is a run-down of the latest change:

[list]
[*] New enemies: racoons, wolves, and owls (oh my!)
[*] Removed enemy: the tiny super-fast squirrels (everyone hated them)
[*] Music and Sound Effects: volume controls have been added to the settings screen
[*] Video: game will now default to full screen but allows switching to windowed mode
[*] Video: game also now conforms to any resolution without black bars
[*] Enemy Speed setting: enemies speed can be set to "casual" which makes them slower and reduces the need to dodge - the default is still "fast" which does generally require dodging to maintain distance and utilize invincibility frames
[*] Auto Traps: This is a new option in the Settings - when selected traps are automatically deployed every 1 second when available and every 0.1 seconds when the Trap Frenzy powerup is active
[*] Auto Clones: This is a new option in the Settings - when selected clones are automatically deployed every 1 second when available and every 0.1 seconds when the Clone Frenzy powerup is active
[*] Various bug fixes
[/list]
